sources.title: Molmo2 (Clark et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Open weights+data (Apache 2.0), no closed-VLM synthetic data; 7 new video + 2 multi-image datasets (dense video captions, free-form video QA, complex-query tracking, video pointing); packing + message-tree recipe, bidirectional vision-token attention, token-weighting; 8B leads open class on short video/counting/captioning, competitive long-video; video-counting 35.5 vs Qwen3-VL 29.6, pointing F1 38.4 vs Gemini 3 Pro 20.0 (author-measured); fully-open Olmo variant.
claims.context: Full-paper abstract (160KB body, abstract+sections consumed); v4 Apr 2026.

claims.text: Comparator role (not paradigm pole): 8B/4B reuse Qwen3 backbones — partial Qwen dependence disclosed; value is openness gradient + grounding-measured video evals.

limitations.text: Author-measured comparisons; Qwen-backbone dependence disclosed; long-video competitiveness is partial.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.finding: Full abstract + repo README consumed: data openness, pointing/tracking evals, Olmo variant verified.
Vendor-measured claims isolated with explicit attribution and role caps; no independent-evaluation inference performed.
